headline: The people we have already built with.

items.quote: Working with The Hope Group changed how I think about what's possible for my business. Rev. Hope took the time to understand exactly where I was — not where he assumed I'd be — and built a plan around my reality. I walked away with a roadmap I could actually use.
items.name: Nicole Wiggins
items.org: City of Boston Certified Small Business

items.quote: As a healthcare AI consultant, I came into the BECMA x The Hope Group AI Series already deep in this work and I still left every session with something I could apply the same day. Chris Hope teaches from the real experience of running a Black-owned business.
items.name: Jennifer Ngure

items.quote: The Hope Group didn't show up and lecture us. They listened first — then built something around how we actually work. As a woman-owned business I needed a partner who understood both the technology and the real-world constraints I operate under. I found exactly that here.
items.name: Ellen Cynar

items.quote: A heartfelt shout out to Rev. Chris, Addison, and Stephen! Thank you for packing BECMA's AI Series with so many amazing, actionable insights! Those 1.5-hour Zoom webinars were an absolute game-changer and such a great investment of my time.
items.name: Susan Paul

items.quote: The Hope Group brings technical excellence and deep community understanding together in a way that is genuinely rare. BECMA is proud to have them as a certified TA vendor and a trusted resource for the businesses we serve.
items.name: Mackenson Charles

items.quote: It was great that you had Addison serving as tech support and team member. She was helpful in a lot of moments that could have taken away from the presentation.
items.name: Titciana Barros

items.quote: Great training. This was the best session. Packed with actionable info from start to finish.
items.name: James "Jimmy" Hills

items.quote: One of the best classes I've taken at BU.
items.name: Sarah Chen
